brief: Macedonian-language business media is a dense and genuinely productive layer for banking and payments intelligence: a specialist portal (Bankarstvo.mk) plus several business desks (еМагазин, Faktor, Пари, Економија и бизнис, Makfax) routinely convert quarterly filings into per-bank profit, deposit and fee-income stories, often within days of the disclosure. The most distinctive value is in signals that have no official counterpart — new tariff books and commission increases (Република, Expres), card/POS/ATM outages and customer disruption (СДК, Bankarstvo.mk, GRID), e-money licensing and wallet launches (МКД.МК, Пари), and management changes (Bloomberg Adria MK, еМагазин). Aggregators (TIME.mk, Daily.mk, GRID.mk, Skrol.mk) are the efficient discovery layer and should be used to dedupe and to snowball into outlets not yet mapped, while Provizii.mk provides the structured fee data underlying the fee journalism. Main open gaps: the business weekly Kapital's current web home was not established, broadcast economy coverage and Albanian-language outlets are unmapped, and no URL in this slice has been liveness- or paywall-tested.
